sql.if: AND t1.ctgry_amd_dt < TO_TIMESTAMP(#{srchEndDd} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + INTERVAL '1 day'

choose.when: ORDER BY t1.ctgry_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" /* 한글 정렬 */ DESC
ORDER BY t2.ctgry_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" /* 한글 정렬 */ DESC , t1.ctgry_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" /* 한글 정렬 */ DESC
ORDER BY t2.ctgry_sort_odrg DESC , t1.ctgry_sort_odrg DESC
choose.otherwise: ORDER BY t2.ctgry_sort_odrg NULLS FIRST, t1.ctgry_sort_odrg

mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL_ID: CategoryMapper.selectCategoryCount */ COUNT(*) FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_category t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_category t2 ON t1.up_ctgry_id = t2.ctgry_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code cd1 ON cd1.mtcd = t1.ctgry_data_sttus_mtcd AND cd1.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00002' WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: CategoryMapper.selectCategoryList */ t1.ctgry_id , t1.up_ctgry_id , t2.ctgry_rdf_cncpt_nm AS up_ctgry_rdf_cncpt_nm , t1.ctgry_nm , t1.ctgry_rdf_cncpt_nm , t1.ctgry_data_sttus_mtcd , cd1.mtcd_nm AS ctgry_data_sttus_mtcd_nm , t1.ctgry_sort_odrg , t1.ctgry_desc , t1.ctgry_eng_nm , t1.ctgry_eng_desc , t1.ctgry_mappg_cd , t1.cntry_cd , t1.ctgry_type_mtcd , t1.ctgry_regr_id , t1.ctgry_regr_nm , to_char(t1.ctgry_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS ctgry_reg_dt , t1.ctgry_amdr_id , t1.ctgry_amdr_nm , to_char(t1.ctgry_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS ctgry_amd_dt , t2.ctgry_nm AS up_ctgry_nm FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_category t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_category t2 ON t1.up_ctgry_id = t2.ctgry_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code cd1 ON cd1.mtcd = t1.ctgry_data_sttus_mtcd AND cd1.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00002' WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: CategoryMapper.selectCategory */ ctgry_id , up_ctgry_id , ctgry_nm , ctgry_rdf_cncpt_nm , ctgry_data_sttus_mtcd , ctgry_sort_odrg , ctgry_desc , ctgry_eng_nm , ctgry_eng_desc , ctgry_mappg_cd , cntry_cd , ctgry_type_mtcd , ctgry_regr_id , ctgry_regr_nm , to_char(t1.ctgry_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS ctgry_reg_dt , ctgry_amdr_id , ctgry_amdr_nm , to_char(t1.ctgry_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS ctgry_amd_dt FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_category t1 WHERE t1.ctgry_id = #{ctgryId}

SELECT /* SQL_ID: CategoryMapper.selectCategoryByConcept */ ctgry_id , up_ctgry_id , ctgry_nm , ctgry_rdf_cncpt_nm , ctgry_data_sttus_mtcd , ctgry_sort_odrg , ctgry_desc , ctgry_eng_nm , ctgry_eng_desc , ctgry_mappg_cd , cntry_cd , ctgry_type_mtcd , ctgry_regr_id , ctgry_regr_nm , to_char(t1.ctgry_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS ctgry_reg_dt , ctgry_amdr_id , ctgry_amdr_nm , to_char(t1.ctgry_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS ctgry_amd_dt FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_category t1 WHERE t1.ctgry_rdf_cncpt_nm = #{ctgryRdfCncptNm}
